SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3244 - 50 West Bryn Mawr Avenue
From B2-3 to B2-3

The Property

The subject property is located in an B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District and in a Transit Served Location per
the Chicago Zoning Ordinance as it is approximately 730.0’ from the CTA Kimball-Homan Bus Corridor (Route
Kimball-Homan 82).

The subject property is improved with a vacant one-story commercial building with approximately 7,000 square
feet of commercial space. The height of the existing building is approximately 20.0’.

The Project

3244 - 50 Bryn Mawr LLC (the “Applicant”) previously rezoned the property to a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-
Use District under a Type ] Map Amendment to authorize four-story building, comprised of the original first floor
fagade and new construction behind, and with a total of 30 residential units, 1,413 square feet of commercial space
and 27 parking spaces and to secure administrative adjustments or variations to reduce the required rear yard
setback under section 17-13-1101-B from 30.0 feet to 3.0 feet on floors that contain dwelling units; and to reduce
the required loading berth from one to zero under section. The Applicant now seeks to amend the previously
approved Type 1 Map Amendment to authorize a five-story building containing 40 residential units, 1,490 sq. ft.
of ground floor commercial space with 25 vehicle parking spaces, 40 bicycle parking spaces and no loading berth.
The building’s zoning height will be 57 ft. 2 in. The facade of the existing building will be retained. As part of
this new Type 1 Map Amendment the Applicant seeks all relief as allowed under the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
for the proposed project, including the following administrative adjustments or variations: 1) to reduce the rear
setback on floors containing dwelling units from 30 feet to 4 feet; 2) to reduce the minimum lot area per dwelling
unit by 4%; and 3) to reduce the required loading berths from 1 to zero. .

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 12,500 square feet

FAR: 3.75

Floor Area: 46,875 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 40

MLA Density: 312.00 square feet

Height: 57 feet 2 inches

Bicycle Parking: 40

Automobile Parking: 25

Loading Berth: 0

Setbacks: Front (Bryn Mawr): 0.0 feet
North (rear): 4.0 feet
East: 0.0 feet
West: 0.0 feet

Attached is a set of plans.
